annotations.title: Course syllabus builder with dated schedule

description: Course syllabus builder with dated schedule — Build a course syllabus (course; optional weeks 1-20 default 12, start YYYY-MM-DD, level, notes): description, measurable objectives, week-by-week topics/readings/activities, assessments and policies. Offline: real Mon-Fri dates for every week, US federal holidays inside each week, assessment weights normalized to exactly 100, non-measurable objective verbs (understand/know/learn) flagged, markdown schedule table. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_syllabus
